en.headline: Hong Kong Food Carnival runs through 1 November with Halloween free entry
en.dek: The 13th edition at Kwai Chung Sports Ground features more than 330 booths across seven zones, with free admission for those in Halloween attire on 30 and 31 October.
body: The 13th Hong Kong Food Carnival, organised by the Chinese Manufacturers’ Association of Hong Kong, is under way at Kwai Chung Sports Ground and continues until 1 November.

More than 330 booths are spread across seven themed zones, including street eats, Southeast Asian flavours, leisure foods, health products and hometown specialities from 11 provinces and cities. Exhibitors have rolled out promotions, and some visitors have spent thousands of dollars on dried seafood and other items early in the day.

On 30 and 31 October, coinciding with Halloween, visitors wearing at least two items of Halloween-themed clothing or make-up can enter free of charge. The carnival also includes ghost parades, craft workshops and free face painting during the holiday period.
Organisers have also introduced discounted food passes distributed at set times each afternoon to ticket holders. Details on booths and activities are available from the organisers.

zh.headline: 第十三屆香港美食嘉年華葵涌舉行至11月1日 萬聖夜穿主題服可免費入場
zh.dek: 廠商會主辦的嘉年華設逾330個撤位、七大主題區，10月30及31日穿至少兩件萬聖節元素服飾或妝容可免入場費。
body: 香港中華廠商聯合會主辦的第十三屆香港美食嘉年華正在葵涌運動場舉行，活動持續至11月1日。
場內設超過330個撤位，分布七大主題區，包括街頭小食、東南亞風味、休閒食品、健康養生及來自11個省市的家鄉風味等。參展商推出多項優惠，有市民一早到場掃貨，消費達數千元購買海味等。
適逢萬聖節，10月30日及31日，市民只要具備至少兩項萬聖節元素的服飾或妝容，即可免費入場。期間亦有嘩鬼大巡遊、創意手作工作坊及免費面部彩繪等活動。
大會另設美食通行券，每日下午指定時段向購票人士派發，詳情可向主辦方查詢。
